Package smart_food_delivery.domain

Class ElectricVehicleDriver

java.lang.Object
smart_food_delivery.domain.Driver
smart_food_delivery.domain.ElectricVehicleDriver
public class ElectricVehicleDriver extends Driver
Represents an electric vehicle delivery driver in the Smart Food Delivery Management System. An electric vehicle driver can deliver an order only when the remaining battery range is sufficient for the delivery distance. The total order size must not exceed 30 items. This class extends Driver and overrides the canDeliver method to apply electric vehicle rules.

      public boolean canDeliver(double distanceKm, int orderSize)
      Checks whether the electric vehicle driver can deliver a specific order. The driver must be available, the delivery distance must not exceed the remaining battery range, and the order size must not exceed 30 items.
